US Senate passes bill allowing 100% tariffs on Russian oil buyers

The U.S. Senate has passed a bill granting President Donald Trump the authority to impose up to 100% tariffs on countries that are major buyers of Russian oil and gas. This legislation could affect India and China, significant purchasers of Russian energy. A White House official suggested that President Trump and Prime Minister Modi would resolve the tariff threat concerning India's Russian oil purchases. Experts offer differing views on the potential impact and India's response.
